gloss: final episode; last installment; final round

definitions.explanation: The concluding episode of a TV drama, anime, manga series, or other serialized work.

definitions.gloss: final round; last inning; last lap
definitions.explanation: The concluding round, inning, or period of a game, competition, or recurring event.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧ (final) and ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (episode, round, installment). Most commonly encountered in entertainment contexts (TV, anime, manga) and in baseball.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}スペシャル: final episode special (extended-length finale)
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the final episode/round
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: final episode broadcast
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結末|けつまつ}→結末：15091_ketsumatsu⟧: ending of the final episode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最終話|さいしゅうわ}: final episode — uses {話|わ} (story/chapter) instead of ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧; often used for anime and manga
- ⟦{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}→千秋楽：16501_senshuuraku⟧: final day of a performance run or sumo tournament — more formal and traditional
- フィナーレ: finale — loanword used for concerts, stage shows, and events
